verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. (B.40) is not a formula but a statement about the order in which the finite parameters can be chosen (Remark B.9; repeated as the last sentence of Corollary B.10 and matched by the quantifier order of Proposition 4.10 on p. 36). The Lean has no single displayed chain; it states the same order as quantifier nesting, and every arrow is covered by a statement I read. (1) M_d, T_d, P_*, lambda, h first: exists_ordered_profile_cone nests m, then P, then lam0, then h; T_d is dropLength = exp m + 10, the paper's T_d = e^{M_d} + 10 (text layer, lines 1778 and 6676). (2) All of these before the tolerance and j_0: exists_ordered_prepared_continuation takes the finished profile F as an argument and then gives 'exists rho, exists jcap, forall |j| <= jcap'. (3) then delta_*, sigma_*, Lambda: 'forall prep : AxisPreparation F j' (fields delta, sigma), then 'exists Λ0, forall Λ >= Λ0'. (4) then (B_k), T_sh: 'exists T' sits after Λ and before C0 in the same statement; ordered_seed_bounds states the bounds B, K, BJ as existing given Λ and before 'forall C' and 'forall T κ w₁ w₂', which is the paper's 'independent of sufficiently large C and of smaller radial transition widths' in Lemma B.7. (5) then C, X_R: 'exists C0, forall C >= C0', with X_R not a separate choice but matchingRadius F C = 110 (C P)^10, and radius_large / eventually_matching_geometry giving that it exceeds any prescribed floor. (6) last kappa_0, t_1, widths: 'exists w : ContinuationWitness' comes after C and E; its RampParameters fields are kappa (the factor in baseSlope = -(damping T κ · stock)/2, the paper's slope -κ p_{1,r}/2), actTime (activation width, the paper's t_1), widthU and widthA (the axial shut-off and the interpolation of a to 4/5, the paper's two final widths), plus a reference cutoff width refTime. The two halves are composed in that order by exists_prepared (outer profile) followed by assembly_exists -> preparedWitness_exists. Differences that remain are packaging: the chain is spread over several theorems, the (B_k) -> T_sh dependence (T from exists_duration (2*BJ)) is visible only inside the proof of exists_ordered_matching_threshold (the display puts both in one group, so it asserts no order between them), Lean quantifies universally over delta_*, sigma_* preparations where the paper chooses them, and Lean carries one extra late parameter (refTime). Finding B's reason for 'different' was the lack of a single declaration and not finding kappa_0 / t_1; the first is allowed packaging and the second is resolved by RampParameters.
